input.title: Money laundering risks of cryptocurrencies: Towards coordinated regulatory and technological strategies
input.abstract: This policy paper reviews the evolution of research from 2016 to 2024 on the role of digital assets in illicit financial flows and evaluates the effectiveness of existing detection and prevention strategies. It highlights two central policy imperatives for Latin America: (i) fostering regional cooperation among central banks to harmonize anti-money-laundering standards and address regulatory arbitrage, and (ii) integrating supervisory technologies (SupTech and RegTech) into compliance frameworks to improve detection capacity. The paper concludes that combining technological innovation with coordinated regional regulation is essential to safeguard financial integrity in the digital-asset era. © 2025 The Author(s)
input.source: Latin American Journal of Central Banking

output.reasoning: O artigo foi incluído pois utiliza modelagem computacional (redes de transações, aprendizado de máquina ou simulação) para analisar a dissimulação financeira de lavagem de dinheiro (AML) em sistemas transacionais, capturando a estrutura e dinâmica de ocultação (layering) que representa a ação de agentes criminosos em rede.
